resources.string: Sharp things pop the bubble. Don\'t touch them!
Something swims back and forth here. Time your moves!
A drain or whirlpool pulls you in. Stay on the edge!
Something is hunting you… keep moving!
Rain drops and lightning will shake the bubble!

string-array.name: world_stories
string-array.item: After the rain, the ant got stuck in a garden puddle. Float it to the dry leaf!
Oops! The ant was washed into the kitchen sink. Watch the tap stream and the drain, reach the sponge!
Bath time! Rubber ducks are cruising and the plug is out. Get to the soap dish!
The ant fell into the aquarium. Goldfish are curious, the filter pushes, the pump makes air bubbles.
A windy garden pond. Hungry frogs are watching from the lily pads…
The pool is open! Jets push you around and the cleaning robot never stops.
The park fountain splashes everywhere. Wish coins wait on the stone island.
A flooded rice paddy. Wind sweeps the water, shrimps and frogs are everywhere.
Low tide at the beach. Crabs patrol, sea urchins hide and waves rush in.
A storm on the lake! Thunder, rain and wild piranhas. Reach the floating log!
Washed into the storm drain. It\'s dark, rats are around and the current is strong.
The basement is flooded and it\'s night. Something is down there with us… find the stairs!

string-array.name: fail_causes
string-array.item: You hit the wall too hard!
The bubble ran out of air!
